implementation.log_masking_evidence: Key was random token_urlsafe(16)+"+/=" (so the percent-encoded form differs from raw). Captured stdout+stderr: raw key hits 0, quote(safe="") hits 0, default-quote hits 0. Exact lines: INFO: 127.0.0.1:59398 - "WebSocket /ws?key=***" [accepted] INFO: 127.0.0.1:59399 - "WebSocket /ws?key=***" 403 (wrong key) INFO: 127.0.0.1:59400 - "WebSocket /ws?key=***" 403 (bad Origin, good key) INFO: 127.0.0.1:59401 - "GET /api/rules?key=*** HTTP/1.1" 200 OK INFO: 127.0.0.1:59402 - "GET /api/rules?key=*** HTTP/1.1" 401 Unauthorized Client results: good ws got subscribed reply; wrong key and bad Origin both "HTTP 403" handshake rejection; REST with header 200, without 401. No-key run: exit code 3, log line "ERROR: app.main: startup failed: APP_API_KEY is not set; generate one with python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))" and put it in .env", then RuntimeError and "Application startup failed. Exiting." The mechanism works as the spec predicted (uvicorn creates its handlers before importing app.main). Not tested with --reload.

design_decisions.decision: require_api_key reads the header via request.headers (not a Header() param) and the key from app.state.services.settings; rejected a closed-over settings so the dependency has no coupling to create_app.

Mask filter is a single KeyMaskFilter installed on uvicorn, uvicorn.error, uvicorn.access and app loggers and their existing handlers, updating the secret on an existing instance instead of stacking; rejected a LogRecord factory (global side effect) since the real run proved the handler walk works.
Filter masks every `[?&]key=value` generically plus the literal key in raw and two percent-encoded forms; short keys would also be replaced anywhere in logs, accepted (real keys are 43 chars).
Missing APP_API_KEY in lifespan raises RuntimeError("APP_API_KEY is not set") after log.error; independent of RULES_PERSISTENCE_ENABLED. create_app() itself never raises.
Dashboard gate uses a module-level listener set (onUnauthorized) rather than a window event; KeyPrompt is a form so Enter also saves.

implementation.claude_md_should_say: API: every /api/* route requires header X-API-Key (shared secret APP_API_KEY, secrets.compare_digest, 401 {"detail":"invalid or missing API key"}); /health is open. /ws requires query key= and an Origin (when present) listed in CORS_ORIGINS, otherwise it is closed with 1008 before accept. Startup fails loudly in lifespan ("startup failed: APP_API_KEY is not set") when the key is empty, independent of RULES_PERSISTENCE_ENABLED; create_app() itself stays callable without a key. app/security.py holds the dependency and KeyMaskFilter, which masks key= in uvicorn/app logs. Compose publishes postgres 127.0.0.1:5433, backend 127.0.0.1:8000, frontend 127.0.0.1:5173; vite server.host is localhost and the proxy targets 127.0.0.1:8000. Frontend keeps the key in sessionStorage, prompts when absent, clears it on 401. Invariant: secrets (including APP_API_KEY) come from .env only and never appear in logs. Tests: TEST_KEY/AUTH in tests/conftest.py, clients send the header, ws tests use /ws?key=TEST_KEY.
